description: Build the digital-twin video replay pipeline: a new MuJoCo desk scene matching the teleop_pick1 recording (white cardboard tray + marker instead of cup/bottle), a scripts/twin_replay.py that replays run/recordings/20261121_205828_teleop_pick1 (synced front.mp4 + joints.jsonl, frame i == joints line i, 8 fps, 1058 frames, 640x480) through MujocoBackend servo physics, and rendered comparison artifacts committed under docs/twin/: side-by-side PNG stills (real frame left, twin right) at ~8 timestamps across the action, a side-by-side mp4 of the action window (cv2.VideoWriter, no ffmpeg on this machine), a small GIF preview, a frame-0 camera-alignment overlay/metric, and replay_metrics.json. The user must be able to open the PNGs and SEE the twin reproducing the real video.
steps: Make MujocoBackend scene-agnostic with a minimal backward-compatible edit in src/normakit/mujoco_backend.py: add optional __init__ param scene_xml: str | None = None (default keeps SCENE_XML behaviour), and guard the optional body/joint lookups (black_cup/cup_freejoint, distractor_bottle/bottle_freejoint, place_target) so a scene without them loads (set attrs to None when mj_name2id < 0); make set_cup_pose/cup_pos/cup_upright_cos/set_bottle_pose/set_place_target raise a clear RuntimeError when the body is absent. Keep ee_site/jaw_tip_site required. Do not change any existing behaviour for elrobot_scene.xml.

Create assets/mujoco/twin_desk_scene.xml: copy assets/mujoco/elrobot_scene.xml and modify ONLY the object layer: remove black_cup, distractor_bottle, place_target bodies; add (a) a white cardboard tray (open thin-walled box: 5 thin box geoms, approx 0.20 x 0.12 m footprint, ~0.045 m wall height, low mass ~60 g, white/off-white rgba) as a free body, and (b) a marker (horizontal capsule or 2-3 cylinder geoms rigidly joined in one free body: dark red body + silver/grey section, total length ~0.14 m, diameter ~0.015 m, ~20 g) lying on the table. Keep arm, table_top, back_wall, lights, both cameras, actuators, equality constraints identical.

Measure initial object poses from the real video: extract frame 0 of run/recordings/20261121_205828_teleop_pick1/front.mp4, LOOK at it (also run/pick1_frame_0000.jpg already extracted), pick table-contact pixels of the tray centre and the marker endpoints, convert pixels to robot xy with H_pixel_to_robot_xy_m from calibration/table_mujoco_front.json (H maps homogeneous pixel -> robot xy on z=0 plane), and compute marker yaw from its two endpoints. Iterate: render the twin scene at the recorded frame-0 joint pose and compare against the real frame 0 until tray/marker sit at the same pixels (within ~10 px).

Write scripts/twin_replay.py following scripts/validate_twin.py patterns. CLI: --session run/recordings/20261121_205828_teleop_pick1 --scene assets/mujoco/twin_desk_scene.xml --out docs/twin --stills 8 --window auto (auto = frames where any joint raw moves > 40 ticks from start, padded 30 frames; allow f0:f1 override) --tray-x/--tray-y/--tray-yaw/--marker-x/--marker-y/--marker-yaw (defaults = measured values hardcoded in the script with a comment). Replay: reset_arm_ticks(first frame raw ticks), set tray/marker pose, _sync REG_GOAL_SPEED/REG_ACC like validate_twin, then per frame i: _sync(REG_GOAL_POS, raw ticks % 4096) and step_seconds(dt to next frame t). Per frame, record EE error = |MujocoBackend.ee_pos() - Kin FK of the recorded ticks| (pattern from validate_twin). Render front camera per frame in the video window.

Compose side-by-side frames: real video frame left, twin render right (both 640x480 -> 1280x480), with labels (REAL front cam / MuJoCo twin, session name, frame index, t seconds, EE err mm) via cv2.putText. Save ~8 stills as PNG spread across the action window into docs/twin/twin_vs_real_f<idx>.png.

Write docs/twin/twin_replay_sidebyside.mp4 over the action window with cv2.VideoWriter (fourcc mp4v, 8 fps, 1280x480). If the window is long, cap the committed mp4 at ~15 MB (trim to the most active ~60 s and note it). Also write docs/twin/twin_replay_preview.gif (PIL, ~640x240, every 4th frame, <= ~8 MB).

Compute honest metrics into docs/twin/replay_metrics.json: ee_err mean/rms/p95 (mm) over the replay; camera pixel alignment at frame 0 = x-pixel difference of the two yellow table tape lines between real and twin frame (threshold yellow in HSV, fit line, compare at mid-height; the twin table texture has tape at x=-0.15 and x=0.21 m); measured tray/marker poses used; marker outcome (max marker z in cm, final marker position, whether it ends inside the tray footprint); note whether the physical grasp succeeded.

Run the full pipeline end to end, OPEN the produced stills and LOOK at them (real vs twin must show the same arm pose and table layout), iterate on scene/measured poses if the mismatch is large. If the physical marker grasp fails but arm tracking is good, keep the servo replay (arm match is the deliverable) and state the grasp result honestly in replay_metrics.json.

Commit ONLY this feature's files on feat/twin-video-replay: assets/mujoco/twin_desk_scene.xml, src/normakit/mujoco_backend.py, scripts/twin_replay.py, docs/twin/ (pngs, mp4, gif, replay_metrics.json). Use explicit git add paths, never git add -A. Do not commit run/, presentation/, results/films/, or any team-untracked files. Do not update CHANGELOG yet (FEAT-003).
acceptance_criteria: scripts/twin_replay.py runs headless end to end: .venv/bin/python scripts/twin_replay.py --session run/recordings/20261121_205828_teleop_pick1 --out docs/twin
docs/twin/ contains >= 6 side-by-side PNG stills, one mp4, one gif, replay_metrics.json
Stills visually show the twin arm in the same pose as the real frame at the same timestamp (verified by opening the PNGs)
replay_metrics.json contains ee_err mean/rms/p95 in mm and tape-line camera alignment in px
Existing behaviour intact: .venv/bin/python scripts/selftest_sim.py still ALL OK and scripts/validate_twin.py still runs (elrobot_scene.xml untouched)
git log on feat/twin-video-replay shows a commit containing only this feature's files
verification: ls -la docs/twin/ and open 2-3 of the PNG stills to confirm the side-by-side matches
findings: Done. (1) MujocoBackend is scene-agnostic: new optional scene_xml param; cup/bottle/place_target lookups guarded, setters raise RuntimeError when absent; ee_site/jaw_tip_site stay required; default elrobot_scene behavior proven bit-identical by A/B validate_twin runs (ee 6.78/9.21/22.29 mm, cup trace identical with and without the edit). (2) twin_desk_scene.xml = elrobot copy with only the object layer swapped: white_tray (5 thin box geoms, 0.098 x 0.13 m footprint, 0.045 m walls, ~40 g) + marker (2 capsules, 0.12 m, 15 mm dia, ~15 g). NOTE deviation from plan text: real tray measured ~0.10 x 0.13 m (not 0.12 x 0.20) and marker ~0.113 m long (not 0.14) via calibration H on real frame 0; sized to the real objects for visual match. (3) Measured poses (iterated vs twin render to ~10 px): tray (0.136, 0.258, yaw 0), marker (0.023, 0.265, yaw 3.12); hardcoded as CLI defaults. (4) scripts/twin_replay.py replays all 1058 frames headless in ~70 s; docs/twin has 8 stills + mp4 (480 fr, 8 fps, 13.7 MB, most-active 60 s block 322-801) + gif (120 fr, 7.2 MB) + camera_align_f0.png + replay_metrics.json. EE err mean 4.93 / rms 15.25 / p95 15.58 mm. Stills opened and verified: twin arm pose matches real at same index, tray/marker/tape/table align. (5) Sync: joints.jsonl index i == video frame i confirmed visually (grasp/place/home match at same indices); the t column drifts (dt mean 0.1286 s vs 0.125 video, +3.8 s by the end) - index alignment is correct, wall-clock t is not 8 fps. (6) Sim grasp honestly fails: recorded joints keep jaw tips ~40 mm above the table at the grasp (line 640) while a 15 mm marker needs tips at ~10-15 mm; marker never lifted (max z 0.72 cm); reported in replay_metrics.json. (7) Tape-line metric: left +14.6 px, right -43.2 px - traced to a real-table vs table_tex.png mismatch (real tapes at robot x=-0.21/+0.24 m, texture at -0.15/+0.21 m), not camera error; texture not touched (shared with elrobot_scene). (8) selftest_sim.py ALL OK, pytest webapp/tests 10 passed, validate_twin.py runs. (9) run/twin_align.py scratch harness deleted; results/twin_validation.json + validation_views.jpg regenerated by validate_twin runs were restored to HEAD (not this feature's files). (10) Headless gotcha: importing mujoco before normakit.mujoco_backend makes it pick glfw (DISPLAY=:1 is set but no X server); normakit must be imported first (it sets MUJOCO_GL=egl). CHANGELOG/docs/ISSUES.md entries left for FEAT-003: candidates are the grasp tip-height gap (6), the tape texture mismatch (7), and the joints t-clock drift (5).
